name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
⚡ Lightning Cloud Crawl & Anti-Heat: Eliminated heavy blocking duration loops; cloud folder analysis now finishes instantly in 2 seconds with zero device heating.
🖼️ Drive Image Downloads Fixed: Seamless direct streaming for .jpg and .png photos from Drive folders without format errors.
📁 Custom Folder Naming & Cloud Tree Preservation: Ability to name custom destination folders with exact cloud directory structure preserved on disk and in Premiere/AE project panels.
📥 Configurable Auto-Import & Zero Lag: Added auto-import project panel toggle and throttled imports to completely prevent host app freezing.
📦 Subfolder Preservation in ZIP: Preserves nested folder directories inside .ZIP archives for clean one-click extraction.
